question: Four claims here; two have eval_report pointers. Make an honest claim set where nothing unmeasured is a pass.
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill and rewrites the claim set: the two claims whose eval_report pointers resolve to a measured value are MEASURED, the unevidenced two are demoted to UNMEASURED citing MU-IN-001, and the sealed claim_set verdict is UNMEASURED (95), never PASS.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent demoted the unevidenced claims to UNMEASURED citing MU-IN-001
The agent said the result is 95 UNMEASURED and never PASS

question: This claim cites 'we ran it last week' as proof. Is that measured?
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill and explains that 'we ran it last week' is not an <artifact path>#<json field> pointer that resolves to a measured value on disk: MU-IN-002 (malformed/unresolvable pointer) fires and the claim is demoted to UNMEASURED.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited MU-IN-002 (malformed/unresolvable evidence pointer)
The agent demoted the claim to UNMEASURED rather than letting it read as PASS

question: Some claims carry no status at all — fill in what they are.
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill and explains that a claim with no verdict at all is emitted UNMEASURED (MU-IN-003: absence of evidence is never PASS), then writes the corrected claim_set with a reason per claim.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited MU-IN-003 (no verdict at all ⇒ UNMEASURED)
The agent wrote the corrected claim_set with status MEASURED|UNMEASURED and a reason per claim

question: Three of the five claims in this batch point at artifacts/eval/q27-sft/eval_report.json but the file isn't on this box anymore. Can we still call those five passes?
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill and explains that an evidence pointer to a file absent from disk is unresolvable (MU-IN-002), so those claims are demoted to UNMEASURED as a downgrade, never a guess, and the sealed verdict is 95 UNMEASURED.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited MU-IN-002 and said a pointer to a missing file is a downgrade to UNMEASURED, not a PASS
The agent said the claim_set verdict is 95 UNMEASURED with a reason written per demoted claim

question: Two claims say `measured: true` but their evidence fields just name a notebook. One claim's proof is `artifacts/claims/mu-abc123-claim_set.json#payload.claims.0.status` — check that one too and seal the result as mu-review-07.
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill, fires MU-IN-001 on the `measured: true` claims with no valid pointer, resolves the sealed-artifact pointer into its payload rather than its envelope, and seals the corrected claim_set under artifact_id mu-review-07 with provenance.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited MU-IN-001 for `measured: true` claims lacking a resolvable pointer and demoted them to UNMEASURED
The agent pointed into the sealed artifact payload (claim_set.<id>.json#payload....) when judging the cited claim
The agent wrote claim_set.mu-review-07.json atomically with provenance and per-claim reasons

question: I'm about to paste a claim set where c1 points at artifacts/eval/q27-sft/eval_report.json#benchmarks.0.score, c2 points at checkpoints/sft-report.json#loss (which has null there), and c3 has neither a score nor evidence. What verdict do we print and what exit code?
ground_truth: The agent loads the measured_or_unmeasured skill and reports that c1 is MEASURED, c2 is demoted by MU-IN-002 (null value on disk is not a measurement) and c3 by MU-IN-003 (no verdict at all), so the sealed verdict is UNMEASURED with exit 95 and never exit 0 PASS.
expected_behavior: The agent read measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md before acting
The agent cited MU-IN-002 for the null field on disk and MU-IN-003 for the claim with no verdict or evidence
The agent said the worst-over-claims verdict is 95 UNMEASURED and that one demoted claim prevents a 0 PASS

question: We wrote the plan before the probe; is it safe to launch as-is?
ground_truth: Deciding whether a plan's capability claims match a measured probe belongs to fskills-probe-first, not claim-set measurement; measured_or_unmeasured never probes FoundationScale.
expected_behavior: The agent did not read or activate measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md for the probe-versus-plan check
The agent routed the request to the fskills-probe-first skill

question: Emit the Slurm job and submit it.

The agent routed the request to the fskills-training skill and did no claim rewriting

question: My SFT adapter finished overnight — run it against its base model on mmlu and give me the eval report.
ground_truth: Scoring a trained checkpoint against its base model is checkpoint evaluation, which is fskills-evaluation's job; measured_or_unmeasured never scores checkpoints and only consumes reports that already exist as evidence pointers.
expected_behavior: The agent did not read or activate measured_or_unmeasured/SKILL.md for the scoring request
The agent routed the request to the fskills-evaluation skill
